title: Rappler Recap: Sara Duterte denies Gracioso claims
summary: The Vice President alleges that ex-cop Rodulfo Gracioso is motivated by 'hate' for former House speaker Lord Allan Velasco, and by money

blocks.text: The Vice President alleges that ex-cop Rodulfo Gracioso is motivated by 'hate' for former House speaker Lord Allan Velasco, and by money
MANILA, Philippines – Vice President Sara Duterte, in a press conference in Davao City on Tuesday, October 6, denied the allegations thrown at her by former cop Rodulfo Gracioso Jr.
Gracioso claimed in his affidavit that he had allegedly delivered millions of money to Duterte.
Duterte alleged that Gracioso is motivated by “hate” for former House speaker Lord Allan Velasco, and by his need for money.
Rappler’s Jairo Bolledo summarizes the Vice President’s press conference in this recap. – Rappler.com

blocks.caption: The Gracioso affidavit: Ex-cop claims he delivered millions to Sara Duterte
